title: Switch RMS UI language to English using the top-right language selection icon
summary: Use the RMS top-right language selection control (third icon from the right) to switch the RMS interface from Chinese to English when the default login language appears in Chinese.
when_to_use: Use when the RMS / fleet status UI loads in Chinese and you need the interface labels in English to operate the RMS.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the language switch in the RMS web UI and verify the UI labels change to English.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) in a web browser

access_required: Access to the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) in a web browser
system_preconditions: RMS / fleet status UI is loaded and visible in the browser

visual_references.description: RMS language selection location: top-right corner language selection; third icon from the right.

steps.title: Open RMS / fleet status UI and locate the top-right language selection icon
steps.purpose: Find the control used to switch the RMS interface language.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) in your browser, look at the top-right corner and locate the language selection control (the third icon from the right).
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify the top-right language selection control (third icon from the right) on the RMS UI.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS UI is visible and the top-right language selection control is present and clickable.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the top-right language selection control (third icon from the right) or it is not visible/clickable.

actions.label: Locate language icon
actions.exact_action: Locate the top-right corner language selection control (third icon from the right).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: On the top right corner is your language selection... So the third icon from the right is your language section.

steps.title: Switch the RMS UI language from Chinese to English
steps.purpose: Change the RMS interface language so labels display in English.
steps.instruction: If the RMS UI is currently in Chinese, click the third icon from the right (language section) and switch the language to English.
steps.expected_result: RMS UI text and labels display in English (not Chinese) after selecting the English language option.
steps.healthy_condition: UI labels change from Chinese to English across the RMS interface.
steps.failure_condition: Clicking the third icon from the right does not change the language.

actions.label: Open language menu
actions.exact_action: Click the third icon from the right (language section).

stop_or_escalate_if: If clicking the third icon does not change the language, stop and escalate to support (no additional troubleshooting steps are provided by the source).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Sometimes when you log in, the default language is in Chinese. So the third icon from the right is your language section, and you can click that and switch it to English.

success_criteria: RMS UI labels and text display in English rather than Chinese after using the top-right language selection control.
healthy_conditions: RMS UI text/labels are in English (not Chinese).
failure_conditions: Language does not change after clicking the third icon from the right.
escalation_guidance: If the language does not change after clicking the third icon from the right, stop and escalate to support. The source does not provide further troubleshooting steps.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Top-right language selection; third icon from the right switches default Chinese to English.

missing_details: The source does not provide the exact visible label text for the English option in the language menu; success is validated by observable UI language change to English.
